prompt: An Illusion Drake soaring in flight, a translucent cerulean dragon with glassy, semi-transparent wings through which pale sky is visible. The creature has hollow cobalt eyes and a phantom body of shimmering blue crystal, catching light like a prism, casting faint rainbow refractions. It banks through the air, wings spread wide. The background is a deep sapphire twilight sky with wisps of silver cloud.

An Illusion Drake in flight, a phantom dragon conjured from pure cerulean magic. Its body is translucent like stained glass, azure and cobalt scales visible but ghostly, wings spread wide showing sky through them. The drake glides forward, mouth open, hollow glowing eyes. The background is a dark indigo night sky with faint stars.

An Illusion Drake soaring in flight, a translucent cerulean dragon with glassy, see-through wings. The creature has hollow cobalt eyes, a phantom body of shimmering blue-white crystal, casting faint prism rainbow refractions where wings catch light. The drake is airborne in profile, wings spread wide showing deep sky through them, tail curling behind. The background is a deep sapphire twilight sky with wisps of silver cloud.

An Illusion Drake stooping in a dive directly toward the viewer, cerulean phantom wings spread wide forward, hollow glowing eyes fixed on us, semi-transparent crystalline body glowing cold blue-white. The drake fills the frame head-on, wings making a broad V-shape, open mouth revealing spectral teeth. The background is a pale twilight sky seen through the creature's own translucent wings.

An Illusion Drake seen head-on from below, wings spread wide in a V-shape, diving toward the viewer. The drake is translucent cerulean and cobalt, a phantom apparition, its hollow glowing eyes staring down, spectral wings showing glimmers of light through them. The body is ghostly blue crystal. The background is a pale moonlit sky with faint aurora shimmer behind the creature.

A robed wizard standing to the left of frame, one hand raised, conjuring a glowing cerulean illusion of a dragon taking shape in the air ahead — made of pure sapphire light, still half-formed, its wings coalescing from wisps of cobalt magic. The wizard squints with concentration. The background is a stone floor and dark castle interior lit only by the conjured light.

A black-robed mage stands to the left in a dark dungeon, arm outstretched, fingers splayed. To the right, a glowing cerulean illusion of a dragon rears up, made entirely of electric blue light with wings spread, its body brilliant sapphire light, clearly conjured and not real — two figures both visible. The only source of light is the conjured drake itself, casting cerulean glow on the stone floor and the mage's robes.

An Illusion Drake in flight, its body mid-shatter — the creature is dissolving at its edges into shards of cerulean crystal, blue glass fragments spinning off into the air. The central mass is still dragon-shaped, glowing cobalt and white, but the extremities are crumbling into sparkling debris. Wings spread wide before the collapse. The background is dark midnight sky.

An Illusion Drake in side profile facing left, a ghostly translucent dragon hovering above dark storm clouds. The drake's body is made of cerulean light and aurora-shimmer, semi-transparent, its wings like stained glass catching moonlight, the deep blue sky visible through them. Its hollow eyes glow cold white. The background is a stormy indigo sky with moonlight breaking through.

Close-up of the Illusion Drake's head and neck in three-quarter view, a phantom dragon face made of cerulean crystal light. Its eyes are hollow glowing cobalt orbs, its scales translucent and shimmering, the background partially visible through its cheekbones and horns. Blue-white luminescence radiates from within its skull. The background is deep indigo midnight with stars.
